title: See You Thursday
content:
I’m taking the day off from the site today — feeling crispy from a little too much work lately. Besides, everyone’s gonna be too busy huffing US midterm election results to pay any attention to anything else. In the meantime, you can spend some time with my poorly timed Election Day post celebrating 10 years of the KDO membership program that gets into all the stuff I’ve been busy working on around here.
